answer: A sybil swarm signs with a borrowed quill, so bind each agent to one hardware root it cannot copy. Use a TPM-bound identity card. First, the agent registers a TPM quote proving its chip serial. Second, the chip signs every job, and the registry rejects a second identity from the same serial. Third, random re-attestation every 30 days revokes cloned cards. Fourth, grove hosts staking per chip lose their stake on fraud. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 chips costing $250,000 plus 30 days of inlet checks per batch. Like a harbor admitting one boat per berth, one chip earns one voice. - Jowy
